title: Kafka on the Shore
author: Haruki Murakami
summary: A fifteen-year-old runs away from home to escape a prophecy and takes shelter in a quiet private library. Meanwhile an elderly man who can talk to cats sets out on a strange errand of his own.
readIf: you like dreamlike stories where the logic is emotional, not literal, and mysteries are left open.
skipIf: you want questions answered, or you are put off by sexual content involving a teenager and a family relationship.

pairings.reason: Murakami's longer, heavier novel with the same blend of ordinary life and slipping reality.
A short, shimmering fantasy that treats the uncanny just as matter-of-factly.
A quiet, puzzle-like novel set in an impossible space that rewards slow, patient reading.
